about.nadaQuote: One who desires complete mastery of yoga should thus explore the nada with an attentive mind and abandon all thoughts.
about.nadaIntro: In 2027, the Jivamukti Yoga community gathers in Luxembourg under the theme of Nada Yoga, and an exploration of the Nadis. Inspired by the lotus, we come together to explore sound as an intricate tool that drives us inwards, through the complex network of roots within - through practice, chanting, silence and our satsang.
about.nadaBody: The practice of Nada yoga invites us to listen with our whole attention. As we become quiet, we begin to notice what the constant movement of thought can obscure. Nada, the inner sound, becomes an object of discipline and focus for meditation: a way of drawing the attention towards the source from which the unstruck sound and stillness arise.
about.verse: Namah Sivaya Gurave Nada-Bindu-Kalatmane, Niranjna-Padam Yati Nityam Yatra Prayanah.
about.verseQuote: "Salutations to the Nadam, which is the inner guide and the inner life, the dispenser of happiness to all! It is the inner guru appearing as nada (sound), bindu (the point of immortality), and kala (time). One who is devoted to the inner guru, the nada, the inner music, obtains the highest bliss."
nadisParagraphs: Where there is life, there is prana. In Sanskrit, pra means moving and na means always. Prana is like electricity, in that electricity exists in the natural world in wild and unpredictable forms. Lightning strikes here and there; you never know where it's going to hit. But if you capture that same electricity inside a wire, its movements become predictable and controllable. The electricity can be conducted via wire from point A to point B. The difference between electricity that will strike anywhere and electricity flowing through a wire is that the latter is useful for turning on lights. (Sharon Gannon & David Life - Jivamukti Yoga, Practices for Liberation).

Nadi is the Sanskrit term for the wires that conduct prana throughout the body. The difference between prana that flows randomly and prana that is consciously directed through the nadis is that the latter is illuminating.

We'll explore the ramifications of the nadis into the body and their role in our self-realization through the metaphor of the Lotus, Padma, which is able to grow and reach the Earth and survive despite the mud and the challenges for it to be in existence.
about.gatheringBody: Jivamukti Tribe Gathering is a four-day Yoga festival celebrating Life and expressing our love and devotion through collective yoga practice, chanting, meditation and satsang. For the first time ever Luxembourg welcomes the worldwide yoga community to join us at our annual Gathering, featuring classes with top Jivamukti Yoga teachers from around the world. Our evening lineup will feature Kirtan, Concerts, Satsang and amazing food! For Jivamukti Students, Teachers, and Yoga Lovers from all across the world! EVERYONE, regardless of age or level, if you are student, teacher, many years practitioner, or new to Yoga, is welcome! Join us!
about.tribeStatement: SATSANG IS OFTEN DEFINED AS THE COMPANY OF LIKE-MINDED PEOPLE IN PURSUIT OF THE TRUTH. WHEN A TRIBE'S COMMON INTEREST IS PURSUIT OF TRUTH – THEN IT IS A SATSANG. THE JIVAMUKTI YOGA GLOBAL SATSANG IS A TRIBE.
tribeParagraphs: Satsang, or the company of like-minded individuals, is a powerful tool for personal and collective growth. By gathering with others who share our interests and values, we can create a supportive and inspiring environment that helps us overcome obstacles, deepen our understanding, and cultivate positive qualities.

In the context of Jivamukti Yoga Global Satsang, this means gathering with fellow practitioners who are committed to the pursuit of truth, liberation from suffering, and the creation of a more peaceful and harmonious world.

Through the experience of satsang, we can also tap into the wisdom and insights of others, and benefit from their perspectives, experiences, and expertise. This can expand our horizons, challenge our assumptions, and help us see things from a new and more enlightened perspective. Moreover, the bonds that we form through satsang can be transformative, fostering a sense of community, belonging, and shared purpose that can sustain us through the challenges of life. Ultimately, satsang is about creating a space where we can connect with others on a deeper level, share our journey, and support each other in becoming the best version of ourselves.

sections.heading: Eligibility
paragraphs: The Jivamukti Tribe Gathering Ticket Giveaway (the "Sweepstakes") is open to legal residents of the United States, the United Kingdom, or the European Union. Entrants must be 18 years of age or older as of their date of entry in order to qualify. The Sweepstakes is subject to all applicable laws and regulations and is void where prohibited by law. Employees of Jivamukti Global Inc., its subsidiaries, affiliates, suppliers, partners, advertising and promotion agencies, and directors (collectively, the "Employees"), as well as members of Employees' immediate families and those living in the same household as Employees, are not eligible to participate.

paragraphs: The sponsor is Jivamukti Global Inc. ("Sponsor"), POB 426, Harriman, New York, 10926, United States. Sponsor will conduct the Sweepstakes substantially as described in these Official Rules.

sections.heading: Agreement to Rules
paragraphs: By entering the Sweepstakes, the entrant ("You") agrees to abide by these Official Rules and the decisions of the Sponsor, which are fully and unconditionally binding in all respects. The Sponsor reserves the right to refuse, withdraw, or disqualify any entry at any time at its sole discretion. By entering, You represent and warrant that You meet the eligibility requirements of these Official Rules, and You agree to accept the decisions of the Sponsor as final and binding.

paragraphs: The Sweepstakes begins on November 1, 2026 at 12:00 AM ET and ends on November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (the "Entry Period"). To be eligible, entries must be received within the Entry Period.

sections.heading: How to Enter
paragraphs: To enter, complete the form at tribe.jivamuktiyoga.com/win and click "Submit." Each person may enter only once. If a person submits more than one entry, all of that person's entries will be disqualified.

If the Winner is unable to attend, the prize will be forfeited and no substitution or cash equivalent will be provided, except at the Sponsor's discretion. The prize is non-transferable. The Winner is solely responsible for all taxes related to the prize. By accepting the prize, the Winner grants permission for the Sponsor to use the Winner's name, likeness, and entry for advertising and promotional purposes without further compensation, unless prohibited by law.

sections.heading: Selection and Notification of Winner
paragraphs: The Winner will be selected by random drawing under the supervision of the Sponsor. The Sponsor is not responsible for and shall have no liability for the Winner's failure to receive notices due to email security settings that cause notifications to be marked as spam or junk, or for the Winner's provision of incorrect or non-functioning contact information.
